title: NodeCapabilitiesResponse
description: HEL-933: `GET /api/pipelines/:id/capabilities?stepId=` -- the node-scoped successor to the retired `GET /api/types/:id/panel-capabilities`. `stepId` is absent for the pipeline's root (a specific step's projected schema vs. the whole pipeline's). Reuses `PanelCapabilityColumnResponse`/`PanelCapabilityResponse` (`com.helio.api.protocols.panels.PanelCapabilityProtocol`) verbatim -- inlined here rather than as their own referenced schema files, since neither is separately gapped by HEL-933 (see design.md Decision 3).

stepId.description: The pipeline node this capability report is scoped to. Absent for the pipeline's root.

capabilities.description: Keyed by `OutputKind.asString` (`table`/`metric`/`chart`/`collection`/`timeline`/`markdown`) -- one `PanelCapabilityResponse` per bindable Output kind.

PanelCapabilityColumnResponse.description: One column of the node's projected shape -- name, wire-string dataType (`DataFieldType.asString`), and nullability.

eligibleColumns.description: Keyed by slot name (every entry in requiredSlots ++ optionalSlots) -- the column names eligible for that slot. Advisory, not a bind-time guarantee.

reason.description: Present only when bindable is false. "not-pipeline-output" carries the V41 rejection text as `message`; any other false carries "missing-required-column-type".

message.description: Present only when bindable is false, alongside reason.
